method.title: What the ledger stands on
method.lead: The entries draw on the Qur'an, the canonical collections, the sirah, and a modern retelling used as a spine. Page numbers are to the MSA NIU English edition of Raheeq al-Makhtum. Hadith links go to sunnah.com where the ledger records a live check.
method.review_note: No scholar has reviewed the atlas yet. It is a study aid, not a teaching authority. If you find an error, report it and the entry will be checked against the sources.
